verses.pali: “Chahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: “Mendicants, someone with six qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Pāṇātipātī hoti, adinnādāyī hoti, kāmesumicchācārī hoti, musāvādī hoti, pāpiccho ca, micchādiṭṭhi ca.
verses.english: They kill living creatures, steal, commit sexual misconduct, and lie. And they have corrupt wishes and wrong view.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, chahi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: Someone with these six qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Chahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge.
verses.english: Someone with six qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, appiccho ca, sammādiṭṭhi ca.
verses.english: They don’t kill living creatures, steal, commit sexual misconduct, or lie. And they have few desires and right view.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, chahi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge”ti.
verses.english: Someone with these six qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.”
